name: cppserver
description: CppServer is a cross-platform asynchronous client/server C++ library with support of TCP, SSL, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket and WebSocket Secure protocols built on top of Asio and OpenSSL.

openssl.description: Use the OpenSSL library built by vcpkg. When this feature is disabled, CMake falls back to find_package(OpenSSL) on the target platform or sysroot (e.g. the OpenSSL dynamic libraries shipped in a Yocto SDK). SSL support is always compiled in.
